patterns.note: Full-bleed hero and section background images are used to establish distinct visual blocks, often with text overlays for content.
Content sections frequently alternate between image-left/text-right and image-right/text-left layouts, creating a dynamic yet balanced flow.
A vibrant, deep green is consistently used as the primary brand accent color for CTAs, the sticky navigation, and the footer, contrasting with light backgrounds and dark text.
The header transforms from a transparent, taller overlay on the hero section to a compact, solid dark green bar with white text and logo as the user scrolls down the page.
Feature comparison sections utilize a clean, multi-column grid layout to clearly present product differences and benefits.

technique_notes: The header employs a scroll-triggered state change: it starts as a transparent, taller element with light text, then transitions to a smaller, solid dark green bar with light text and logo once the scroll position moves past the initial hero section. This is likely achieved with CSS keyframes or JavaScript event listeners.

Full-bleed lifestyle imagery serves as a background for entire sections, with text content placed directly over it. A subtle dark gradient or overlay is applied to these images to ensure text readability.

Content sections are revealed through standard vertical scrolling, with no complex entrance animations for individual elements within those sections; the focus is on clear presentation as content enters the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are large and bold, creating a strong visual hierarchy, while body text is clear and highly readable with a balanced line height.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card elements, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and comfortable padding within content blocks, contributing to a sense of openness.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, vibrant green as a primary brand color, consistently applied across navigation, CTAs, and footer, creates a strong, memorable brand identity. This is effectively paired with high-quality, full-bleed lifestyle imagery that integrates the product seamlessly.
